NEUVILLETTE1_EPOCH.title: The Call
NEUVILLETTE1_EPOCH.unlock: [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] heard a [sine]whale's call[/sine] from beyond the universe. The Sovereign of the distant seas was about to enter the [gold]Spire[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE1_EPOCH.description:
Affairs at the [blue]Palais Mermonia[/blue] were many and complex, and [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] was always busy. [sine]"Crime takes no holiday, and so justice has no time to rest."[/sine]

One [sine][blue]rainless[/blue][/sine] afternoon, he suddenly heard [jitter][aqua]the call of a whale[/aqua][/jitter].

As the [sine][aqua]master of the seas, the oceans, and all waters[/aqua][/sine], he sensed that the voice came neither from [blue]Fontaine[/blue], nor from [green]Teyvat[/green], nor even from this [purple]universe[/purple]:
[thinky_dots][aqua]"...Honored... Lord of the Distant Sea..."[/aqua][/thinky_dots]
NEUVILLETTE1_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Complete a run{IsRevealed:| to reveal this history node}.
NEUVILLETTE_CHARACTER_NEUVILLETTE2_EPOCH: [blue]Neow's[/blue] plea crossed the curtain of rain. [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] resolved to leave Fontaine for a time and travel to the [gold]Spire[/gold].

[thinky_dots]"...The [gold]Spire[/gold]... filled with evil... the [jitter][purple]Blight[/purple][/jitter]... crossing worlds..."[/thinky_dots]

A gigantic [sine][aqua]whale-like creature[/aqua][/sine] calling herself [blue]Neow[/blue] appealed to [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] for help. From her he learned that a terrible disaster called the [jitter][purple]Blight[/purple][/jitter] would be spread across [green]Teyvat[/green] by the [red]evil man[/red] atop the [gold]Spire[/gold].

[sine][blue]Rain began to fall[/blue][/sine]. [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] decided it was time for a business trip.
Complete [gold]Act 1[/gold] as [blue]Neuvillette[/blue]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this history node}.
Unlock cards: [blue]Commanding Presence[/blue], [blue]Laminar Flow[/blue], and [blue]Objection Overruled[/blue].
NEUVILLETTE_CHARACTER_NEUVILLETTE3_EPOCH: [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] solemnly submitted a leave request written and approved by himself, and accepted a mailbox sent by the people of Merusea Village.

A [b]business trip[/b] for [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] was a rare occurrence.

[jitter]"Are you truly going away, Monsieur [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua]?"[/jitter] The diminutive [pink]Melusine[/pink] was astonished.

[aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] solemnly handed [pink]Sedene[/pink] a [gold]leave request[/gold] that he had [b]written and approved himself[/b]. To his surprise, she gave him a [sine][gold]mailbox covered in stickers[/gold][/sine].

[sine][aqua]"...If anything happens, everyone in Merusea Village will write to you!"[/aqua][/sine]
Complete [gold]Act 2[/gold] as [blue]Neuvillette[/blue]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this history node}.
Unlock relics: [blue]Gavel[/blue], [blue]Excuse Note[/blue], and [blue]Sea Foam Mailbox[/blue].
NEUVILLETTE_CHARACTER_NEUVILLETTE4_EPOCH: Before leaving, [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] visited an opera star and accepted a ticket to her performance.

After temporarily entrusting his duties to [purple]Clorinde[/purple], [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] prepared to leave [green]Teyvat[/green].

Before departing, however, he intended to visit a certain [pink]opera star[/pink].

[jitter]"Huh? Even a workaholic like you takes vacations?"[/jitter] His former superior stared at him in disbelief.

After several failed attempts to explain that this was a [b]business trip[/b], the [sine][aqua]noble Hydro Dragon[/aqua][/sine] let the matter drop. Before he left, he accepted a [gold]ticket[/gold] to one of her performances.

[sine]"Well, for you, I suppose it isn't much different from a vacation."[/sine]
Complete [gold]Act 3[/gold] as [blue]Neuvillette[/blue]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this history node}.
Unlock cards: [blue]Procedural Justice[/blue], [blue]Public Condemnation[/blue], and [blue]Hydro Dragon... Hydro Dragon...[/blue].
NEUVILLETTE5_EPOCH.title: Keepsakes
NEUVILLETTE5_EPOCH.unlock: A worn feather stirred [aqua]Neuvillette's[/aqua] memories of an old companion. It seemed that her belongings still lingered within the [gold]Spire[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE5_EPOCH.description:
The [aqua]Sovereign of the Waters[/aqua] arrived on [orange]Preon[/orange] and, under the rules of the [red]"evil" man[/red] at its summit, began his ascent of the [gold]Spire[/gold].

As expected, the [gold]Spire[/gold] was perilous beyond measure for ordinary people. Yet [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] saw none of the devastation of an [jitter][purple]overflowing Blight[/purple][/jitter].

During his climb, he happened upon a [sine][gold]worn feather[/gold][/sine]. The image of a [jitter][orange]woman sailor laughing heartily[/orange][/jitter] surfaced in his mind.

[sine]"How did these things... come to be here?"[/sine]
NEUVILLETTE5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Defeat 15 Elites as [blue]Neuvillette[/blue]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this history node}.
NEUVILLETTE6_EPOCH.title: A Helping Hand
NEUVILLETTE6_EPOCH.unlock: Rain fell upon the [gold]Spire[/gold] for days. [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] offered his aid to a group of companions climbing the same path.
NEUVILLETTE6_EPOCH.description:
[aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] was not the only one climbing the [gold]Spire[/gold].

Within it, he met a [red]warrior[/red] deceived by an [gold]unlawful contract[/gold], a [green]hunter[/green] grievously afflicted by the [jitter][purple]Blight[/purple][/jitter], a [pink]lich[/pink] with a blood feud against the [red]evil man[/red], an [blue]automaton[/blue] seeking to repair itself and its friends, and a [jitter][orange]noisy pointy-headed friend[/orange][/jitter].

[sine][blue]The rain did not cease for days[/blue][/sine]. He helped them however he could. Except...

[jitter][orange]"Come listen, damp friend! Your king has found another symphony worthy of royalty—[/orange][sine][rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1]a masterpiece for the ears[/rainbow][/sine][orange]!"[/orange][/jitter]
NEUVILLETTE6_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Defeat 15 Bosses as [blue]Neuvillette[/blue]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this history node}.
NEUVILLETTE7_EPOCH.title: The Primordial Sea
NEUVILLETTE7_EPOCH.unlock: [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] entered the [rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1]Primordial Sea[/rainbow]. What had happened once before must not be allowed to happen again.
NEUVILLETTE7_EPOCH.description:
At last, [aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] met the [red]"evil man"[/red]—the [red]Architect[/red] of the [gold]Spire[/gold].

He wished only to learn the truth, but the Architect repeatedly cast him back to the foot of the Spire through the power of his [jitter][red]"laws"[/red][/jitter]. After many meetings, the white-haired man finally relented and told him of the designs of the [blue]Mother of Resurrection[/blue] and the [purple]Beast of Stars[/purple].

[sine][red]"One as great as you should never have become involved in this."[/red][/sine] The Architect looked exhausted.

[aqua]Neuvillette[/aqua] entered the [sine][rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1]Primordial Sea[/rainbow][/sine]. At this point, he was forced to consider no longer recognizing [jitter][purple]whales[/purple][/jitter] as his subjects.

[sine][aqua][b]"What happened once before must not be allowed to happen again."[/b][/aqua][/sine]
NEUVILLETTE7_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Win a run as [blue]Neuvillette[/blue] at [gold]Ascension 1[/gold] or higher{IsRevealed:| to reveal this history node}.
